title: Director of Nursing
role: Lead clinical operations for a 200-bed skilled nursing facility. Accountable for survey readiness and regulatory compliance, nurse staffing ratios across three shifts, infection control, care plan quality, and retention of an RN and CNA workforce in a market where every competitor is short-staffed. You own clinical outcomes and the budget that produces them.
